programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: With the occasion all but overshadowed by her sister's upcoming wedding, angst-ridden Samantha (Molly Ringwald) faces her 16th birthday with typical adolescent dread. Samantha pines for studly older boy Jake (Michael Schoeffling), but worries that her chastity will be a turnoff for the popular senior. Meanwhile, Samantha must constantly rebuff the affections of nerdy Ted (Anthony Michael Hall), the only boy in the school, unfortunately, who seems to take an interest in her.

programme.title: The Breakfast Club
programme.desc: Five high school students from different walks of life endure a Saturday detention under a power-hungry principal. The disparate group includes rebel John, princess Claire, outcast Allison, brainy Brian and Andrew, the jock. Each has a chance to tell his or her story, making the others see them a little differently -- and when the day ends, they question whether school will ever be the same.

programme.title: Back to the Future Part III
programme.desc: In this final chapter, Marty McFly (Michael J. Fox) obtains a 70-year-old message from the time-traveling Dr. Emmett Brown (Christopher Lloyd), in which he informs Marty that he has retired to a small town in the Old West. Marty then finds out that the Doc was murdered shortly after sending the letter. In order to save his friend, Marty will have to travel back in time, disentangle a lovestruck Doc from a local schoolmarm, and repair the DeLorean -- all while avoiding a posse of gunslingers.

programme.title: Back to the Future Part II
programme.desc: In this zany sequel, time-traveling duo Marty McFly and Dr. Emmett Brown return from saving Marty's future son from disaster, only to discover their own time transformed. In this nightmarish version of Hill Valley, Marty's father has been murdered and Biff Tannen, Marty's nemesis, has profited. After uncovering the secret to Biff's success -- a sports almanac from the future -- Marty and the Doc embark on a quest to repair the space-time continuum.

programme.title: Back to the Future
programme.desc: In this 1980s sci-fi classic, small-town California teen Marty McFly is thrown back into the '50s when an experiment by his eccentric scientist friend Doc Brown goes awry. Traveling through time in a modified DeLorean car, Marty encounters young versions of his parents, and must make sure that they fall in love, or he'll cease to exist. Even more dauntingly, Marty has to return to his own time and save the life of Doc Brown.

The treaty that binds the two groups is threatened when some of the town leaders learn that the Native American land contains rich deposits of silver. Eager to oust the tribes and claim the silver, the town leaders try to provoke an attack that would break the treaty. It's up to Eddie to stop them in time.

programme.title: Hostiles

Embarking on a harrowing and perilous journey from Fort Berringer, N.M., to the grasslands of Montana, they soon encounter a young widow whose family was killed on the plains. The travelers must now band together to survive a punishing landscape that's crawling with hostile Comanches and vicious outliers.

programme.title: Leprechaun 2

He kidnaps teenager Bridget (Shevonne Durkin), grotesquely murdering anyone who gets in his way. It falls to Bridget's boyfriend, Cody (Charlie Heath), to rescue her. Cody enlists the aid of his perpetually tipsy uncle, Morty (Sandy Baron), who decides to go after the homicidal leprechaun's pot of gold.

programme.title: Leprechaun 3
programme.desc: One night in Las Vegas, a pawn shop owner purchases a statue of a leprechaun from a mysterious stranger. He ignores the stranger's warning to never remove the statue's golden medallion and takes it for himself. Instantly the statue transforms into the murderous Leprechaun (Warwick Davis), who vows to kill anyone who takes his gold. Scott McCoy (John Gatins), who unwittingly took a gold coin from the pawn shop, and Tammy (Lee Armstrong), Scott's new friend, are first on the list.

programme.title: Leprechaun 4 in Space
programme.desc: Resurfacing on an alien planet, the Leprechaun (Warwick Davis) abducts a member of the world's royalty, Princess Zarina (Rebekah Carlton), in an attempt to wed her and become the supreme ruler. Unfortunately for the diminutive schemer, well-armed soldiers arrive to foil his plans. Not easily defeated, however, the feisty Leprechaun continues to battle the warriors while also contending with the warped scientist known as Dr. Mittenhand (Guy Siner).

It takes young poet Laura Riding to reignite Robert's passion, and with the blessing of wife Nancy, his muse becomes his lover. With the three of them sharing a life, Laura's attention soon turns to Nancy, and their complicated relationship threatens to risk everything they have.

programme.title: Fences
programme.desc: Troy Maxson makes his living as a sanitation worker in the 1950s Pittsburgh. Maxson once dreamed of becoming a professional baseball player, but was deemed too old when the major leagues began admitting black athletes. Bitter over his missed opportunity, Troy creates further tension in his family when he squashes his son's chance to meet a college football recruiter.

programme.title: The Perfect Gamble
programme.desc: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino.

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

programme.title: Kickback
programme.desc: A documentary following the decades-long crusade of investigative journalist Andrew Jennings to expose corruption inside FIFA, football's sole governing body and the largest sports organization in the world.

programme.title: Kiss the Girls
programme.desc: Successful forensic psychologist Alex Cross (Morgan Freeman) discovers that his niece has gone missing. Once he consults with police Detective Nick Ruskin (Cary Elwes), Cross believes that the disappearance is the work of an insane killer known as "Casanova." Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova.

programme.title: Out of the Furnace
programme.desc: Steelworker Russell Baze works a dead-end job and holds tight to his sense of family, duty and loyalty. Rodney Baze, Russell's brother, returns home after serving in Iraq and, with his debts piling up, becomes entangled with a vicious crime lord. Soon afterward, Rodney disappears mysteriously. The police fail to solve the case, so Russell -- feeling he has little left to lose -- puts his life on the line to bring his brother home.

programme.title: The Perfect Gamble
programme.desc: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Two years before the Civil War, Django (Jamie Foxx), a slave, finds himself accompanying an unorthodox German bounty hunter named Dr. King Schultz (Christoph Waltz) on a mission to capture the vicious Brittle brothers. Their mission successful, Schultz frees Django, and together they hunt the South's most-wanted criminals. Their travels take them to the infamous plantation of shady Calvin Candie (Leonardo DiCaprio), where Django's long-lost wife (Kerry Washington) is still a slave.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: Boozy writer Marty (Colin Farrell) is a man in search of a screenplay. He has a catchy title but no story to go along with it. Marty has a couple of oddball buddies, Hans (Christopher Walken) and Billy (Sam Rockwell), who make a living by kidnapping rich people's dogs, then returning them and collecting the reward. However this time, the fur flies when Hans and Billy kidnap the beloved pooch of a gangster (Woody Harrelson), and Marty uses the ensuing events as fodder for his screenplay.

programme.title: Fences
programme.desc: Troy Maxson makes his living as a sanitation worker in the 1950s Pittsburgh. Maxson once dreamed of becoming a professional baseball player, but was deemed too old when the major leagues began admitting black athletes. Bitter over his missed opportunity, Troy creates further tension in his family when he squashes his son's chance to meet a college football recruiter.

programme.title: Good Morning, Vietnam
programme.desc: Radio funny man Adrian Cronauer (Robin Williams) is sent to Vietnam to bring a little comedy back into the lives of the soldiers. After setting up shop, Cronauer delights the G.I.s but shocks his superior officer, Sergeant Major Dickerson (J.T. Walsh), with his irreverent take on the war. While Dickerson attempts to censor Cronauer's broadcasts, Cronauer pursues a relationship with a Vietnamese girl named Trinh (Chintara Sukapatana), who shows him the horrors of war first-hand.

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Jerry Shaw (Shia LaBeouf) and Rachel Holloman (Michelle Monaghan) are two strangers whose lives are suddenly thrown into turmoil by a mysterious woman they have never met. Threatening their lives and family, the unseen caller uses everyday technology to control their actions and push them into increasing danger. As events escalate, Jerry and Rachel become the country's most-wanted fugitives and must figure out what is happening to them.

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: U.S. Navy pilot Lt. Jake Grafton (Brad Johnson) and his bombardier buddy, Lt. Cmdr. Virgil Cole (Willem Dafoe), are two soldiers embedded in the Vietnam War growing frustrated by the military's constraints on their missions. Despite the best efforts of their commanding officer, Cmdr. Frank Camparelli (Danny Glover), to re-engage them, this disillusioned pair decide to take the war effort into their own hands with an explosive battle plan that could well get them court-martialed.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: Commodus (Joaquin Phoenix) takes power and strips rank from Maximus (Russell Crowe), one of the favored generals of his predecessor and father, Emperor Marcus Aurelius, the great stoical philosopher. Maximus is then relegated to fighting to the death in the gladiator arenas.

programme.title: Star Trek: Section 31
programme.desc: Emperor Philippa Georgiou faces the sins of her past after joining a secret division of Starfleet that's tasked with protecting the United Federation of Planets.

programme.title: Masterminds
programme.desc: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him.

programme.title: Good Morning, Vietnam
programme.desc: Radio funny man Adrian Cronauer (Robin Williams) is sent to Vietnam to bring a little comedy back into the lives of the soldiers. After setting up shop, Cronauer delights the G.I.s but shocks his superior officer, Sergeant Major Dickerson (J.T. Walsh), with his irreverent take on the war. While Dickerson attempts to censor Cronauer's broadcasts, Cronauer pursues a relationship with a Vietnamese girl named Trinh (Chintara Sukapatana), who shows him the horrors of war first-hand.

programme.title: Hacksaw Ridge
programme.desc: The true story of Pfc. Desmond T. Doss (Andrew Garfield), who won the Congressional Medal of Honor despite refusing to bear arms during WWII on religious grounds. Doss was drafted and ostracized by fellow soldiers for his pacifist stance but went on to earn respect and adoration for his bravery, selflessness and compassion after he risked his life -- without firing a shot -- to save 75 men in the Battle of Okinawa.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: Commodus (Joaquin Phoenix) takes power and strips rank from Maximus (Russell Crowe), one of the favored generals of his predecessor and father, Emperor Marcus Aurelius, the great stoical philosopher. Maximus is then relegated to fighting to the death in the gladiator arenas.

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: Trailer-dwelling, sewage-pumping Chip may not lead the most glamorous life, but he's got one thing going for him: he's head over heels infatuated with his girlfriend, Liza. So when she proposes a plot to steal $68,000, he goes along with the plan. But when what was supposed to be a simple heist turns into an off-the-rails, blood-spattered crime spree, Chip learns the hard way just how deranged the love of his life really is.

programme.title: Kindred
programme.desc: A pair of twisted, young criminals decide to break into a mansion for one big score, but they soon find out that the owners of the house are much more dangerous than they are.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: Based upon the best-selling book "We Were Soldiers Once ... and Young" by Lt. Gen. Harold G. Moore (Ret.) and journalist Joseph L. Galloway, this compelling war drama depicts the true story of the first major battle between the United States and North Vietnamese forces. It is a film about uncommon valor and nobility under fire, loyalty among soldiers, and the heroism and sacrifice of men and women both home and abroad.

programme.title: The Resurgence: DeMarcus Cousins
programme.desc: A documentary following DeMarcus Cousins while he recovers from an injury that has been a career death sentence for some NBA players; featuring exclusive interviews with teammates, coaches and NBA insiders.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps.

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody...

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: In the final installment to this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer(s).

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: A transplanted New Yorker attempting to acclimate to Los Angeles, Mike Peters (Jon Favreau), is struggling to both boost his comedy career and get over his last relationship. A self-proclaimed master of seduction, Mike's buddy, Trent Walker (Vince Vaughn), tries to show him how to make connections and get the attention of women. Slowly moving toward regaining his confidence, Mike meets the gorgeous and down-to-earth Lorraine (Heather Graham), sparking a welcome new romance.

programme.title: Clerks
programme.desc: Dante (Brian O'Halloran) is called in to cover a shift at his New Jersey convenience store on his day off. His friend Randal (Jeff Anderson) helps him pass the time, neglecting his video-store customers next door to hang out in the Quick Stop. The uneventful day is disrupted by news that one of Dante's ex-girlfriends has died. After attending her memorial service, Dante muses over staying with current girlfriend Veronica (Marilyn Ghigliotti) or reuniting with ex Caitlin (Lisa Spoonhauer).

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly.

programme.title: Jackass: Number Two
programme.desc: Daredevils (Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O) go for the gross-out when they subject an unsuspecting public to more outrageous stunts and practical jokes. Danger, pain and bodily fluids are in plentiful supply as the gang tries to up the ante in the continuous quest to shock and annoy.

programme.title: Certain Women
programme.desc: Three strong-willed women (Kristen Stewart, Laura Dern, Michelle Williams) strive to forge their own paths amidst the wide-open plains of the American Northwest: a lawyer who finds herself contending with both office sexism and a hostage situation; a wife and mother whose determination to build her dream home puts her at odds with the men in her life; and a young law student who forms an ambiguous bond with a lonely ranch hand.

programme.title: Mean Creek
programme.desc: Quiet adolescent Sam (Rory Culkin) has been bullied by George (Josh Peck), a fellow student who has trouble fitting in with other teens. When Rocky (Trevor Morgan), Sam's elder brother, finds out Sam is being picked on, he enlists his buddies to help get back at George. They ask George to accompany them on a boating expedition deep in the woods, but when their plan to humiliate George horrifically backfires, the friends make a series of poor decisions that will change their lives.

programme.title: The Outlaws
programme.desc: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly.

programme.title: Personal Shopper
programme.desc: A young American in Paris works as a personal shopper for a celebrity. She seems to have the ability to communicate with spirits, like her recently deceased twin brother. Soon, she starts to receive ambiguous messages from an unknown source.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: After more than 30 years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators, Pete "Maverick" Mitchell is where he belongs, pushing the envelope as a courageous test pilot and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him. Training a detachment of graduates for a special assignment, Maverick must confront the ghosts of his past and his deepest fears, culminating in a mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice from those who choose to fly it.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Brad Whitaker (Will Ferrell) is a kindhearted radio executive who wants to be the best possible stepfather to his wife's (Linda Cardellini) two children. When her freewheeling ex-husband, Dusty (Mark Wahlberg), breezes back into town, Brad's feeling of insecurity quickly develops into an inferiority complex. As Dusty demonstrates his flair for athletics, home repair and bad-boy charisma, Whitaker finds himself in a no-holds-barred battle to one-up his rival and win the approval of his family.

programme.title: Quantum of Solace
programme.desc: Following the death of Vesper Lynd, James Bond (Daniel Craig) makes his next mission personal. The hunt for those who blackmailed his lover leads him to ruthless businessman Dominic Greene (Mathieu Amalric), a key player in the organization which coerced Vesper. Bond learns that Greene is plotting to gain total control of a vital natural resource, and he must navigate a minefield of danger and treachery to foil the plan.

programme.title: Deepwater Horizon
programme.desc: On April 20, 2010, the Deepwater Horizon drilling rig explodes in the Gulf of Mexico, igniting a massive fireball that kills several crew members. Chief electronics technician Mike Williams (Mark Wahlberg) and his colleagues find themselves fighting for survival as the heat and the flames become stifling and overwhelming. Banding together, the co-workers must use their wits to make it out alive amid all the chaos.

programme.title: Anthropoid
programme.desc: In December 1941, two Czech soldiers (Cillian Murphy, Jamie Dornan) parachute into their occupied homeland to assassinate Nazi officer Reinhard Heydrich (Detlef Bothe).

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: A top Marine sniper, Bob Lee Swagger, leaves the military after a mission goes awry and disappears without a trace. Swagger is coaxed back into service after high-profile government officials convince him to help thwart a plot against the President of the United States. Swagger realizes he has been betrayed and becomes the target of a nationwide manhunt. Instead of hiding, he seeks revenge against some of the most powerful and corrupt leaders in the free world.

programme.title: The Gunman
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: One of an elite group of assassins, Arthur Bishop (Jason Statham) may be the best in the business. Bishop carries out his assignments with precision, detachment and adherence to a strict code, but when Harry (Donald Sutherland), his close friend and mentor, is murdered, Bishop vows revenge. Harry's son (Ben Foster) comes to him with vengeance in his heart and a desire to learn Bishop's trade, signaling the birth of a deadly partnership.

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: In the late 1980s, Ace (Wood Harris) is a young man employed by a Harlem dry cleaning shop, working hard to stay out of the drug business. While making deliveries, he meets Lulu (Esai Morales), a drug dealer who convinces Ace to join him. Ace recruits his friends Mitch (Mekhi Phifer) and Rico (Cam'ron), and the trio become major players in the Harlem drug underworld, a violent business that will test the friends' loyalty and wits as the money rolls in and the dangers grow beyond their control.

programme.title: Last Vegas

programme.desc: Tattletales is an American game show which first aired on the CBS daytime schedule on February 18, 1974. It was hosted by Bert Convy, with several announcers, including Jack Clark, Gene Wood, Johnny Olson and John Harlan, providing the voiceover at various times.The show's premise involved questions asked about celebrity couples' personal lives and was based on He Said, She Said, a syndicated Goodson-Todman show that aired during the 1969—1970 season.

programme.title: Concentration
programme.desc: One of NBC's longest-running programs, this seminal game show was a daytime staple from 1958 to '73, with forays into prime time in '58 and '61. Of all the emcees who revealed the rebus (Ed McMahon and Bob Clayton among them), Hugh Downs is the one best remembered. In 1987, the series was resurrected as `Classic Concentration,' with Alex Trebek as host until the show's end in 1994.

programme.title: Concentration
programme.desc: One of NBC's longest-running programs, this seminal game show was a daytime staple from 1958 to '73, with forays into prime time in '58 and '61. Of all the emcees who revealed the rebus (Ed McMahon and Bob Clayton among them), Hugh Downs is the one best remembered. In 1987, the series was resurrected as `Classic Concentration,' with Alex Trebek as host until the show's end in 1994.

programme.title: Tattletales
programme.desc: Tattletales is an American game show which first aired on the CBS daytime schedule on February 18, 1974. It was hosted by Bert Convy, with several announcers, including Jack Clark, Gene Wood, Johnny Olson and John Harlan, providing the voiceover at various times.The show's premise involved questions asked about celebrity couples' personal lives and was based on He Said, She Said, a syndicated Goodson-Todman show that aired during the 1969—1970 season.

programme.desc: S03 E13 — Catholics vs. Convicts The fascinating backstory behind the famous/infamous 1988 "Catholics vs. Convicts" college football game between Notre Dame and the University of Miami. The slogan summarized the subtext of cultural and racial tensions brewing between the schools.

programme.title: ACC Huddle
programme.desc: Louisville Football Preview ACC Huddle, ACCN's signature football show, airs on Saturday mornings this fall. Host Kelsey Riggs and analysts Eric Mac Lain, EJ Manuel, Mark Richt, and Eddie Royal go on the road to preview the weekend's slate of ACC football games.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Oklahoma at Tennessee The No. 18 Sooners (6-2, 2-2 SEC) seek revenge against the No. 14 Volunteers (6-2, 3-2). Tennessee topped Oklahoma 25-15 in 2024 in their first meeting as SEC rivals. The Vols are second among FBS programs in scoring at 45.6 points per game.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Oklahoma at Alabama The No. 11 Sooners (7-2, 3-2 SEC) visit the No. 4 Crimson Tide (8-1, 6-0) in this marquee matchup. Alabama has won eight straight after burying LSU, 20-9 out of its bye Nov. 8. Oklahoma shocked then-No. 14 Tennessee 33-27 before its week off Nov. 1.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Missouri at Oklahoma The No. 8 Sooners take on the No. 22 Tigers. Oklahoma leads the all-time rivalry series 67-25-5, but Missouri won the first meeting as SEC equals in 2024. Oklahoma has defeated then-No. 14 Tennessee and then-No. 4 Alabama on the road in November.

programme.title: Unsportsmanlike with Evan, Canty and Michelle
programme.desc: Start the day off right with Chris Canty, Evan Cohen and Michelle Smallmon providing an energizing and informative way to take on the day. Sports, life and laughter are what it's all about.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: LSU at Oklahoma The No. 8 Sooners (9-2, 5-2 SEC) surge into a regular-season finale with the Tigers (7-4, 3-4). Oklahoma has won three straight games, all against Top 25 teams, and would all but assure itself a spot in the College Football Playoff by beating LSU.

programme.title: 30 for 30
programme.desc: S02 E07 — Survive and Advance North Carolina State, coached by Jim Valvano, was a huge underdog in the 1983 NCAA Final vs. top-ranked Houston - resulting in one of the greatest college basketball upsets ever.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Texas-El Paso at Texas A clash of 1-1 Lone Star State programs sees the Miners visit the No. 7 Longhorns. Arch Manning threw for 295 yards and accounted for five TDs as Texas rolled past San José State 38-7 on Sept. 6. Texas blasted UTEP 59-3 in their last meeting in 2020.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Texas at Florida The No. 9 Longhorns (3-1, 0-0 SEC) visit the Gators (1-3, 0-1). Last season, Texas smashed Florida in the schools' first meeting since 1940, as Jerrick Gibson burned his hometown school for 100 rushing yards and a TD to lead the Horns' 49-17 victory.

programme.title: Unsportsmanlike with Evan, Canty and Michelle
programme.desc: Start the day off right with Chris Canty, Evan Cohen and Michelle Smallmon providing an energizing and informative way to take on the day. Sports, life and laughter are what it's all about.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Oklahoma vs. Texas The undefeated No. 6 Sooners (5-0, 1-0 SEC) face the Longhorns (3-2, 0-1) in another edition of the Red River Rivalry from the Cotton Bowl. Texas, the preseason No. 1, fell from the AP Top 25 after dropping its SEC opener 29-21 at Florida on Oct. 4.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Texas at Kentucky Arch Manning leads the No. 21 Longhorns (4-2, 1-1 SEC) into this outing with the Wildcats (2-3, 0-3). Manning threw for 166 yards and a TD when Texas stunned then-No. 6 Oklahoma in the Red River Rivalry on Oct. 11. Texas beat Kentucky 31-14 in 2024.

programme.title: TrueSouth
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Birmingham Greek natives and their kin built the Birmingham restaurant scene, from barbecue joints to hot dog stands to steakhouses; Bright Star, founded in 1907, is the old guard and Johnny's is the new guard Greek restaurant.

programme.desc: S08 E02 — Charleston, S.C. The subject of endless magazine listicles and breathless influencer reels; is it possible to sidestep the algorithms and really see and hear and taste Charleston?

programme.title: Authentic ACC
programme.desc: Louisville Spring Football In this edition of the series produced by Louisville Athletics, get an inside look at Spring Football for the 2025 Louisville Cardinals.

programme.title: Authentic ACC
programme.desc: Miami Spring Football In this edition of the series produced by Miami Athletics, get an inside look at Spring Football for the 2025 Miami Hurricanes.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Texas at Mississippi State The No. 22 Longhorns head to Starkville, Miss., to play the Bulldogs. Texas has won five of its past six after outlasting Kentucky 16-13 in overtime Oct. 18. Entering Week 9, Texas' defense ranked third nationally, allowing only 11.3 points per game.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Vanderbilt at Texas The No. 9 Commodores (7-1, 3-1 SEC) visit the No. 20 Longhorns (6-2, 3-1). Texas defeated Vanderbilt 27-24 in 2024 in the first meeting since 1928. Vandy hung on for a 17-10 victory last week as a Hail Mary pass by Missouri came up one yard short.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Texas at Georgia The No. 5 Bulldogs host the No. 10 Longhorns. In 2024, Georgia beat Texas 30-15 in the regular season, and 22-19 in overtime in the SEC title game. Texas held off then-No. 9 Vanderbilt for a fourth straight win Nov. 1. Georgia has won five in a row.

programme.title: Unsportsmanlike with Evan, Canty and Michelle
programme.desc: Start the day off right with Chris Canty, Evan Cohen and Michelle Smallmon providing an energizing and informative way to take on the day. Sports, life and laughter are what it's all about.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Arkansas at Texas The No. 17 Longhorns (7-3, 4-2 SEC) battle the Razorbacks (2-8, 0-6). Texas picked up a 20-10 decision at Arkansas in 2024, but fell 35-10 at then-No. 5 Georgia on Nov. 15 to end a four-game winning run. The Razorbacks have dropped eight in a row.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Texas A&M at Texas The unbeaten No. 3 Aggies face the No. 16 Longhorns in a Lone Star Showdown tilt. Texas A&M finds itself in the driver's seat for both an SEC title-game appearance and College Football Playoff berth after starting 11-0 for the first time since 1992.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Cheez-It Citrus Bowl: Michigan vs. Texas Storied programs in the No. 13 Longhorns and the No. 18 Wolverines line up in the Citrus Bowl from Orlando, Fla. Both sides are 9-3. The schools meet for the third time after the Longhorns defeated the Wolverines 31-12 in 2024.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Stanford at BYU The Cardinal clash with the Cougars from Provo, Utah. Stanford has been off since Aug. 23, when it lost its season opener 23-20 to Hawaii on a last-second field goal. BYU smoked Portland State 69-0 on Aug. 30. BYU took down Stanford 35-26 in 2022.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: BYU at East Carolina The Cougars clash with the Pirates. East Carolina has outscored its opposition 94-3 during its two-game win streak. BYU is 2-0, outscoring foes 96-3. East Carolina stunned BYU 27-24 with a game-winning field goal as time expired on Oct. 28, 2022.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: BYU at Colorado The No. 25 Cougars begin their Big 12 slate with a game against the Buffaloes at Folsom Field. With Kaidon Salter back at starting quarterback, Colorado dumped Wyoming 37-20 to improve to 2-2 on Sept. 20. BYU is 3-0 for the third straight season.

programme.title: Authentic ACC
programme.desc: North Carolina Spring Football In this edition of the series produced by North Carolina Athletics, get an inside look at Spring Football for the 2025 UNC Tar Heels.

programme.title: Authentic ACC
programme.desc: SMU Spring Football In this edition of the series produced by SMU Athletics, get an inside look at Spring Football for the 2025 SMU Mustangs.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: BYU at Arizona The Cougars (5-0, 2-0 Big 12) try for their fifth straight victory over the Wildcats (4-1, 1-1). BYU is 5-0 for the fourth time in six years following a 38-24 win over West Virginia. Arizona quarterback Noah Fifita has accounted for 16 touchdowns.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: BYU at Texas Tech A clash of Big 12 elites sees the No. 8 Red Raiders (8-1, 5-1) host the No. 7 Cougars (8-0, 5-0). Both sides boast a ranked win over Utah this year, with Texas Tech prevailing 34-10 on the road Sept. 20 and BYU grinding out a 24-21 home win Oct. 18.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: TCU at BYU The No. 12 Cougars (8-1, 5-1 Big 12) try to bounce back when they host the Horned Frogs (6-3, 3-3). TCU has won five in a row over BYU after a 44-11 result in 2023 in their first meeting since 2011. BYU fell 29-7 at then-No. 8 Texas Tech on Nov. 8.

programme.desc: S05 E22 — Rope-a-Dope When Marlon and Shawn (Marlon Wayans, Shawn Wayans) auction off boxing memorabilia, boxing champion Roy Jones Jr. (guest starring as himself) is a bidder.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Goop-Hair-It-Is Marlon invents a really hot hair-care product; with Gary Coleman, Greg Morris.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S01 E02 — First Class Marlon and Shawn (Marlon and Shawn Wayans) are given the red-carpet treatment when Marlon is mistaken for a basketball star.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S01 E03 — I'm Too Sexy for My Brother Marlon (Marlon Wayans) is crushed when Shawn (Shawn Wayans) tries to horn in on his new modeling career.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Free Wally Marlon risks breaking a promise to stay off of Shawn and Lisa's love boat forever when he surfaces to smooth out rough waters.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S01 E05 — My Fair Marlon Marlon (Marlon Wayans) uses Shawn's (Shawn Wayans) poetry to woo a woman, only to have his plan backfire.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Pops Moves In After a fight with his wife, Pops (John Witherspoon) moves in with Shawn and Marlon (Shawn and Marlon Wayans).

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S01 E07 — Afro Cab The brothers start a cab company which is soon in financial trouble.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S01 E08 — The Shawn-Shank Redemption Shawn and Marlon are thrown into jail for unpaid parking tickets.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S01 E09 — ER Marlon (Marlon Wayans) borrows Shawn's (Shawn Wayans) insurance card after accidentally sitting on a staple gun.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S01 E10 — The Poppa-Cabana Seeing a golden financial opportunity, Marlon and Shawn (Marlon and Shawn Wayans) turn the diner into a high-priced nightclub.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S01 E11 — It's Shawn, It's Marlon, It's Superboys Shawn and Marlon (Shawn and Marlon Wayans) are promised jobs as supers by their obnoxious slumlord. Guest star: Sherman Hemsley.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S01 E12 — Pulp Marlon Marlon and Shawn (Marlon and Shawn Wayans) are placed on a mob hit list because of Marlon's dream girl's jealous husband. Guest star: Paula Jai Parker.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S01 E13 — Brazilla vs. Rodney Shawn and Marlon find some angry competition when they decide to go into the children's entertainment business.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S02 E01 — Shawn Takes a New Stand When Shawn (Shawn Wayans) is laid off, he swallows his pride to ask Pops (John Witherspoon) for a loan.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S02 E02 — Fatal Subtraction When Shawn's (Shawn Wayans) girlfriend (Garcelle Beauvais) showers him with gifts, Marlon (Marlon Wayans) sees her as controlling.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S02 E03 — Blood Is Thicker Than Watercolor When Marlon (Marlon Wayans) is mistaken for a rising artist, his head swells until Lou (Jill Tasker) bursts his bubble.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S02 E04 — Two Men and a Baby Shawn and Marlon (Shawn and Marlon Wayans) find a baby on their doorstep with a note claiming one of them is the father.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S02 E05 — Loot Shawn and Marlon (Shawn and Marlon Wayans) find $100,000 stashed in a garbage bag and debate its destiny.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S02 E06 — The Liars Club Marlon (Marlon Wayans) tells Monique (Paula Jai Parker) his true feelings about her while she's pretending to be married to Shawn (Shawn Wayans).

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: S02 E07 — Scared Straight At the request of a frightened Shawn and Marlon, Monique holds a seance to put a restless spirit at peace.

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
programme.desc: S01 E04 — These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Why LA's Danger Dog is the Best Thing You'll Ever Eat Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs.

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
programme.desc: S01 E05 — The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S06 E03 — The Most Underrated Game Bird Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Turkey Tenders and Salmon Chef Andrew Zimmern shares his favorite way to prepare wild turkey breast, pan-fried over an open fire. Served with cheese sauce and jalapeno-bacon wild rice. Then, cooks a simple meal of seared salmon and a side of crispy potatoes and onions.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S03 E10 — Hawaiian Plate Lunch Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S02 E05 — Chicken Fried Deer and Creole Halibut Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares chicken fried axis deer. Next, Chef Zimmern poaches halibut in tomato roux.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Summer-y Sweet Pea Risotto and Slow Roasted Pork Jamie celebrates summer with roasted fennel pork & gratin, oozy pea risotto, and rainbow slaw chicken wraps. He shares edible hanging basket tips. The feast finishes with stunning mackerel on sun-dried tomato couscous with colorful beets.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
programme.desc: S01 E05 — Buddy's Strawberry Rice Pudding and Summer Tomato Chicken Bake Jamie cooks a chicken sheet pan dinner with early tomatoes, potatoes and chorizo. Buddy helps pick strawberries for quick jam rice pudding. The summer feast ends with spicy shrimp skewers with homegrown chillies and a refreshing cucumber gazpacho.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Endless Summer: From Grilled Panzanella Salad to Sour Cherry Tart Jamie ends summer with crispy duck in a rich plum sauce & roast potatoes. Grilled peppers star in panzanella. Garden zucchini become Mediterranean rice. Sweet finale: sour cherry frangipane with crème fraîche.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Crispy Chicken Oven Hack Jamie hacks his oven into a rotisserie for crispy chicken and chips and bakes a savory spinach and feta pie. Then, the Godfather of Spanish cuisine, Jose Pizarro, shares some gorgeous Mediterranean flavours using just 5 everyday ingredients.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Pantry Pasta and Rice Pudding Pops Jamie raids his pantry for a speedy veggie carbonara and rice pudding popsicles.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Freezer Friendly Favorites Jamie turns frozen fish and veggies into a time saving supper. Then, Italian chef, Gennaro Contaldo rustles up some delicious homemade gnocchi using just 5 easy ingredients.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Shake Up Your Salads Jamie's dressing a salad with a crown of cheese! He's also got a speedy twist on Sunday roast chicken and an elegant apple tart all with 5 fabulous ingredients.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S03 E15 — Pizzapalooza Chef Dale Talde is throwin' down a pizza spread like never before with his Chicago-style tavern pie with sausage & onion, a grilled pizza pocket with pepperoni & cheese, chicken wings a la pizzaiola, and a zesty grilled Caesar salad to finish it off.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S05 E07 — Pizza-Town Dale reinvents pizza night: grilled pizza bagels loaded with pepperoni, mozzarella-stuffed penne vodka pie, a massive grilled chop salad, and olive oil cake with burnt orange caramel. Pizza goals achieved.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S03 E04 — Luxe Lobster & Prime Rib Chef Dale Talde pulls out all the stops for this daddy-sized dinner. He grills up prime rib with herb & horseradish crust, lobster & chili sauce American, charred green beans with garlic tahini, and cheddar-stuffed parker house rolls.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S05 E06 — Taco Like It's Hot Taco night, Dale-style! Puffy al pastor tacos stuffed with pineapple-chile pork, grilled chicken pipian with charred tomato sauce, crispy street corn ribs, and dulce de leche empanadas. Taco Tuesday who?

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S04 E05 — World of Burgers! It's burger day! Chef Dale tackles three classics with a full flavor spin. Game changing Pho Burgers with bone marrow, toasted milk bread Ahi Tuna patty melts, and Chori Pan Burgers with a fried egg and shrimp chips.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S04 E06 — Grilled Loco Moco and Huli Huli Chicken The options are plentiful when Chef Dale smothers grilled Loco Moco with a mushroom gravy, salty and sweet Huli Huli Chicken with charred pineapple, and healthy scoops of Tuna Water Chestnut poke or mac salad.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S05 E08 — Thanksgiving On The Grill Thanksgiving goes to the grill with Chef Dale-juicy spatchcock turkey, grilled sage-cornbread stuffing, smoked green bean casserole, and pumpkin donut bread pudding drenched in bourbon brown butter sauce.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S04 E03 — Wok Cooking On A Charcoal Grill Anything is possible with a wok and a good ol' charcoal grill, at least if you're Chef Dale, who throws together a heavenly spread of fiery eats, from drunken meats, stir-fried veggies, and stir-fried noodles.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S04 E02 — Yakitori and More-Y Don't sleep on grilled chicken, especially if it's Chef Dale night to cook! He's serving up Japanese style yakitori three ways, from spicy to sweet to zesty, with crispy rice, and of course he adds his own flair to these delicious skewered snacks.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S04 E04 — Caribbean Latin BBQ Comforting and familiar but full of island flavor, right from the grill! Chef Dale roasts pork shoulder with chicharrones, steamy coconut rice and pigeon peas finished with frozen coconut rum drink with a charred banana.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Venison and Duck Gumbo Chef Andrew Zimmern grills his favorite tender cuts of venison and serves it with coal-roasted sweet potatoes. Then, he cooks a hearty pot of classic Louisiana gumbo using wild duck and grills crispy-skinned duck breast for the topping.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel! Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S02 E01 — Boar Ribs and Shrimp and Grits Chef Andrew Zimmern makes a homemade barbecue rub, basting sauce and barbecue sauce for wild boar ribs. Next, chef shares his twist on a classic southern shrimp and grits recipe, adding a side of beautiful wild mushrooms.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. programme.title: El turco
programme.desc: S01 E01 — El soldado turco Un jenízaro herido en batalla es rescatado por Gloria, bruja de un oprimido pueblo italiano. Una vez recuperado, él decide partir en busca de venganza, sin imaginar la tragedia que se avecina.

programme.title: El turco
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Lucha o sacrificio Hasan se integra a la vida en Moena mientras Gloria, al verse en peligro, enfrenta un dilema moral. Las intrigas de la bruja y Lady Diana provocan el inevitable encuentro entre Marco y Balaban.

programme.title: El turco
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Respuesta sangrienta Marco acampa a las afueras de Moena y usa todos sus recursos para lograr la victoria. El jenízaro tiene un plan, pero necesita el apoyo del pueblo. La traición provoca dolorosas consecuencias.

programme.title: El turco
programme.desc: S01 E04 — El punto de no retorno Hasan decide enfrentar a Marco, aunque desconoce las oscuras intenciones de su antiguo compañero de batalla y de Lady Diana. Una prueba confirma la victoria y una carta provoca conmoción.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: S10 E01 — Operación Michoacán La cacería contra Aurelio entra en una nueva fase cuando Castillo activa la Operación Michoacán. Una revelación sobre Rutila lo obliga a tomar decisiones extremas que lo llevan a un rescate.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: S10 E02 — Vida y muerte Aurelio enfrenta presión de la DEA mientras Castillo intensifica la operación en su contra. Lucy y Nina se reúnen para ubicar a Rutila, quien enfrenta el riesgo de morir en manos de Cifuentes.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: S10 E03 — La culpa El futuro de Skinny está en manos de Aurelio, que escucha los consejos de Diana, Felina e Isidro. La muerte de Ismael lo tiene afectado y se culpa a sí mismo. Consuelo se aprovecha del banco.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: S10 E04 — Notorius La tensión financiera aumenta, mientras Constanza detecta transacciones ilegales en cripto. Dalila confirma el secuestro digital y recomienda hacer un pago a Notorius para evitar el colapso.
